notes.title: Under Canopies: New Updates!
notes.content:
[h2]✨ Hello everyone! ✨[/h2]

I want to start by thanking you all for the incredible support and enthusiasm you’ve shown for Under Canopies. Your interest and feedback have been instrumental in improving the game, and today I’m thrilled to share some of the latest updates as I work towards the Early Access release.

I’ve received lots of impressions and suggestions after playing the free demo on Steam, and I want you to know that I’ve taken your feedback seriously to refine and expand the game’s experience. Here are the most important updates:

[h3]🛠️ Improved Building System[/h3]

The building system is now more intuitive and easier to use. Additionally, I’ve added triangular pieces to allow for more varied and creative structures. I’ve also implemented a new feature that lets you dismantle the structures you’ve built and recover some of the resources used. This gives you greater flexibility to modify and personalize your designs throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984994/5864dc7119d2846fb54ae63856aba483f51c5cb0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984994/a8a7416a2118d6191e2ba54e33dc071eb7818b8d.jpg[/img]

[h3]🍳 Cooking System Upgrades[/h3]

The cooking system has also received a significant upgrade. I’ve added new recipes to expand the options available and improved the cooking process to make it more dynamic and enjoyable. Every aspect of cooking is designed to be a rewarding and straightforward experience in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984994/fd7f456698bd8f005f2182fe5533e4ba381ce0e9.jpg[/img]

[h3]🌱 In Development: Harvesting System[/h3]

I’m currently working on a new harvesting system. This will allow you to plant, care for, and collect vegetables that will be essential for unlocking new recipes and expanding your culinary possibilities. This system is designed to be simple, fun, and consistent with the relaxing experience I want to deliver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984994/9b4996cfe4b456f116bd14745d09bea3e02e4bab.jpg[/img]

It’s important to note that these features and improvements will no longer be available in the free demo, as I’m now fully focusing my efforts on preparing the Early Access version. I want to make sure the next version of the game is as complete and enjoyable as possible.

Thank you again for all your support and for being part of this amazing community. Every step I take in development is focused on giving you the best possible experience. Stay tuned—more updates are coming soon!

[b]🌲 Novemtails[/b]

notes.title: New demo version available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce an update for the demo of my game! This new version comes with tons of bug fixes, environment improvements, new areas to explore, and even a map!

I want to thank you all for the amazing support so far. Since I'm developing the game on my own, your feedback and recommendations are super important to me. I want to create the best survival game possible, and your opinions really help shape the future of the project.

Feel free to join the Discord channel to share your thoughts on this update: https://discord.com/invite/rmvmWTe6xX. I'd love to hear what you think!

Thanks again, and happy exploring!

notes.title: New demo available
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm super excited to announce that a new demo for my game is now available for download! I've poured a lot of hard work and love into this, and I truly hope you enjoy it.

Please keep in mind that this is a demo, so you might come across some bugs or unfinished features. Rest assured, I’m continuously working on improvements and updates.

Your feedback is incredibly important to me, so please share your thoughts and suggestions on our Discord server. Join us here: https://discord.gg/PsqsJkAsMJ

Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!

Cheers

Novemtails
